regime_context: The detector for Hong Kong shows a narrow eligible universe (7 of 17 themes) led by Conglomerates & Exchange, with high durability (0.73) and full breadth (1.0). The top momentum theme (Diversified Miners) is ineligible due to weak absolute trend. Only two scorable themes exist (both China tech) and both are ineligible, consistent with a risk-off trend in that space. The absolute-trend gate is validated for drawdown control on this market, so eligibility is the primary discipline.

theses.subject: Conglomerates & Exchange
